success.name: 4000/2098当前单宠首位自身存活时按整1%失体力增攻，末位自身令对手实际用技能后全PP回1，药剂与控制不触发
success.assertion: test('4000/2098当前单宠首位自身存活时按整1%失体力增攻，末位自身令对手实际用技能后全PP回1，药剂与控制不触发',()=>{const a=make({move:10047,soul:true,hp:4500}),b=make({move:10047,soul:false,hp:4500});turn(a,10047,20309);turn(b,10047,20309);assert.ok(Math.abs(red(a)/red(b)-1.5)<.05);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].pp[key(10047)],source.moves.find(m=>m.id===10047).pp);for(const hp of[8911,8910,8909]){const x=make({move:10047,soul:true,hp,aStats:{atk:1800}}),y=make({move:10047,soul:false,hp,aStats:{atk:1800}});turn(x,10047,20309);turn(y,10047,20309);assert.ok(Math.abs(red(x)/red(y)-(hp===8911?1:1.01))<.005);}for(const action of['potion','control']){const s=make({move:10047,soul:true});if(action==='control')s.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫']=2;turn(s,10047,action==='potion'?null:20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10047)],source.moves.find(m=>m.id===10047).pp-1);}});

success.name: 4000全部17招基础组件以不同双攻面板验证真实分类、源威力公式、HP变化及PP，明确隔离另行验证的效果指令
success.assertion: test('4000全部17招基础组件以不同双攻面板验证真实分类、源威力公式、HP变化及PP，明确隔离另行验证的效果指令',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,index:-1,aStats:{atk:180,spa:18}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);const events=(s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.targetSide===1&&e.type==='attack');if(m.kind==='status'){assert.equal(events.length,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);continue;}assert.equal(events.length,1);const event=events[0],attack=m.kind==='physical'?180:18,defense=m.kind==='physical'?s.fighters[1].stats.def:s.fighters[1].stats.spd;assert.equal(event.attackValue,attack,m.name);const log=s.turns[0].events.find(e=>e.damage?.sourceSide===0&&e.damage?.type==='attack'),roll=Number(log.detail.match(/浮动 (\d+)%/)[1]),base=Math.floor(Math.floor((2*s.fighters[0].level/5+2)*m.power*attack/defense)/50)+2,affinity=E.typeEffectiveness(m.type,s.fighters[1].type,s.typeChart),expected=affinity===0?0:Math.max(1,Math.floor(base*E.sameTypeBonus(m.type,s.fighters[0].type,s.typeChart)*affinity*roll/100));assert.equal(event.settledDamage,expected,m.name);assert.equal(event.hpLoss,expected);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000-expected);}});

success.assertion: test('4000全部17招64种子基础验证与真实魂印完整链含2493七参、2492零盾罩，实际末位回复PP独立核对',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),old=E.SOULS;let used=false;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&c.actualUsed&&c.m.kind!=='item')used=true;}};try{turn(s,m.id,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.id===38422?m.pp:m.pp-1+(used?1:0),m.name);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}});

review.rationale: 22661/9f8af798/index0/125[3,250]与旧4194/4278/4400/4499/3425完全相同，复用Q-N20-4438-001既有整回合完整红250预算；当前多段、护盾100后150+100、保1实际0仍完整250、次回重置、三回到期、固定50独立均真实验证。其他125实例使用各自来源对应的确认规则，不将本实例整回合预算推广到整招预算实例。

success.name: 4000/125同版22661已确认整回合完整红250，多段累计、真实HP与PP、次回重置及三回到期
success.assertion: test('4000/125同版22661已确认整回合完整红250，多段累计、真实HP与PP、次回重置及三回到期',()=>{const s=create(),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(22661)];turn(s,22661,10703);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(22661)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8750);assert.equal(sum(s),250);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['攻击伤害上限'].cumulativeRoundRed,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['攻击伤害上限'].pending1254854,undefined);turn(s,10047,10703);assert.equal(sum(s),250);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8500);turn(s,10047,10703);assert.equal(sum(s),250);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8250);turn(s,10047,10703);assert.ok(sum(s)>250);});

success.assertion: test('4000/125同源盾100后完整红150加100，保1实际失血0仍消耗完整250预算',()=>{for(const mode of['shield','floor']){const s=create();if(mode==='shield')s.fighters[0].suitState.shield=100;else{s.fighters[0].hp=1;timer(s,0,'致命保留',{hp:1});}turn(s,22661,10703);assert.equal(sum(s),250);if(mode==='shield'){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.shield,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8750);assert.deepEqual(attacks(s).filter(e=>e.settledDamage>0).map(e=>e.settledDamage),[150,100]);}else{assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1);assert.ok(attacks(s).filter(e=>e.settledDamage>0).every(e=>e.hpLoss===0));}}});

success.assertion: test('4000/2228对手固粉输出减少80%不影响真实，946低于对手HP全强翻倍及843下两回先制2',()=>{const s=make({move:38420,index:4}),old=E.SOULS,out={};E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,500,'减伤实测',type);out[type]=hp-c.t.hp;}}};try{turn(s,38420,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.deepEqual(out,{fixed:100,percent:100,true:500});const baseline=make({move:38421,index:-1});turn(baseline,38421,20309);const afterHitHp=9000-sum(baseline);for(const hp of[afterHitHp-1,afterHitHp,afterHitHp+1]){const x=make({move:38421,index:1,hp});turn(x,38421,20309);for(const n of Object.values(x.fighters[0].stages))assert.equal(n,hp<afterHitHp?2:1);}const p=make({move:38421,index:3});turn(p,38421,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].effects.id984.amount,2);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].effects.id984.start,2);});

success.assertion: test('4000全部17招基础组件以不同双攻面板验证真实分类、源威力公式、HP变化及PP，明确隔离另行验证的效果指令',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,index:-1,aStats:{atk:180,spa:18}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);const events=(s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.targetSide===1&&e.type==='attack');if(m.kind==='status'){assert.equal(events.length,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);continue;}assert.equal(events.length,1);const event=events[0],attack=m.kind==='physical'?180:18,defense=m.kind==='physical'?s.fighters[1].stats.def:s.fighters[1].stats.spd;assert.equal(event.attackValue,attack,m.name);const log=s.turns[0].events.find(e=>e.damage?.sourceSide===0&&e.damage?.type==='attack'),roll=Number(log.detail.match(/浮动 (\d+)%/)[1]),base=Math.floor(Math.floor((2*s.fighters[0].level/5+2)*m.power*attack/defense)/50)+2,affinity=E.typeEffectiveness(m.type,s.fighters[1].type,s.typeChart),expected=affinity===0?0:Math.max(1,Math.floor(base*E.sameTypeBonus(m.type,s.fighters[0].type,s.typeChart)*affinity*roll/100));assert.equal(event.settledDamage,expected,m.name);assert.equal(event.hpLoss,expected);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000-expected);}});

success.name: 4000/58两回攻击必暴，10/12/14五行之光25%独立异常成功失败及22疲惫30%，命中免疫不补抽
success.assertion: test('4000/58两回攻击必暴，10/12/14五行之光25%独立异常成功失败及22疲惫30%，命中免疫不补抽',()=>{const s=make({move:22662,loadout:[22662,10047,22660,14897,38423]});turn(s,22662,20309);const b=structuredClone(s);delete b.fighters[0].effects['必定暴击'];turn(s,10047,20309);turn(b,10047,20309);assert.ok(sum(s)>sum(b)*1.4);const found=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=32&&found.size<4;seed++){const x=make({move:14898,seed:seed*987654321});turn(x,14898,20309);for(const k of['麻痹','烧伤','冻伤'])if(x.fighters[1].ailments[k])found.add(k);if(Object.keys(x.fighters[1].ailments).length===0)found.add('none');}assert.deepEqual(new Set(found),new Set(['麻痹','烧伤','冻伤','none']));const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=24&&seen.size<2;seed++){const x=make({move:14899,seed:seed*987654321});turn(x,14899,20309);seen.add(!!x.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫']);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);});

success.assertion: test('4000全部17招基础组件以不同双攻面板验证真实分类、源威力公式、HP变化及PP，明确隔离另行验证的效果指令',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,index:-1,aStats:{atk:180,spa:18}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);const events=(s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.targetSide===1&&e.type==='attack');if(m.kind==='status'){assert.equal(events.length,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);continue;}assert.equal(events.length,1);const event=events[0],attack=m.kind==='physical'?180:18,defense=m.kind==='physical'?s.fighters[1].stats.def:s.fighters[1].stats.spd;assert.equal(event.attackValue,attack,m.name);const log=s.turns[0].events.find(e=>e.damage?.sourceSide===0&&e.damage?.type==='attack'),roll=Number(log.detail.match(/浮动 (\d+)%/)[1]),base=Math.floor(Math.floor((2*s.fighters[0].level/5+2)*m.power*attack/defense)/50)+2,affinity=E.typeEffectiveness(m.type,s.fighters[1].type,s.typeChart),expected=affinity===0?0:Math.max(1,Math.floor(base*E.sameTypeBonus(m.type,s.fighters[0].type,s.typeChart)*affinity*roll/100));assert.equal(event.settledDamage,expected,m.name);assert.equal(event.hpLoss,expected);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000-expected);}});

success.assertion: test('4000/2494前轮实际攻击值260阈值产生冰系属性伤害，2495未受攻则26%盾罩同源刷新，属性伤害不当作攻击历史',()=>{for(const atk of[259,260,520]){const s=make({move:29371,index:2,loadout:[29371,10047,22660,14897,38423],bStats:{atk}});turn(s,10047,10127);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.sourceSide===1&&e.type==='attack').attackValue,atk);turn(s,29371,20309);const e=es(s).find(e=>e.redCategory==='attribute');assert.ok(e);assert.equal(e.settledDamage,Math.floor(170*2**Math.floor(atk/260)*E.typeEffectiveness('冰',s.fighters[1].type,s.typeChart)));assert.equal(e.hpLoss,e.settledDamage);}const x=make({move:29371,index:3});turn(x,29371,20309);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].suitState.shield,2340);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].suitState.barrier,2340);turn(x,29371,20309);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].suitState.shield,2340);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].suitState.barrier,2340);});

success.name: 4000/2493负先制按零档，残血仍按理论汲取回复，技能禁疗与真伤免疫分别处理
success.assertion: test('4000/2493负先制按零档，残血仍按理论汲取回复，技能禁疗与真伤免疫分别处理',()=>{for(const priority of [-3,-1,0,1,2,4]){const s=make({move:38422,index:4,hp:1000,targetHp:1000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;known2493(s,priority);const n=340*2**Math.max(0,priority);assert.equal(es(s,'true')[0].settledDamage,n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+n);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp>=0);if(priority===4)assert.ok(es(s,'true')[0].hpLoss<n);}for(const mode of ['ban','immune']){const s=make({move:38422,index:4,hp:1000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');else timer(s,1,'当回合免伤');known2493(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='ban'?1000:1340);assert.equal(es(s,'true').reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0),mode==='immune'?0:340);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38422)],4);}});

success.assertion: test('4000/2489与2494真实同招：异常条件把冰系属性附伤改神灵且强制本系1.5，状态招仍无凭空主攻击伤害',()=>{const s=make({move:29371,loadout:[29371,10047,22660,14897,38423]});turn(s,10047,10127);s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=4;turn(s,29371,20309);const events=es(s);assert.equal(events.length,1);assert.equal(events[0].redCategory,'attribute');assert.equal(events[0].settledDamage,Math.floor(170*1.5*E.typeEffectiveness('神灵',s.fighters[1].type,s.typeChart)));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);});

success.name: 4000/2494实际多段对应攻击值不同时按最后一次计算冰系附伤
success.assertion: test('4000/2494实际多段对应攻击值不同时按最后一次计算冰系附伤',()=>{const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4995/snapshot.json'),s=make({move:29371,index:2,loadout:[29371,10047,22660,14897,38423],enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[10703,20276,20565,11141,38550]}),old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===1)c.stage(c.a,1,['spa']);}};try{turn(s,10047,10703);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}const values=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===1&&e.type==='attack').map(e=>e.attackValue);assert.ok(new Set(values).size>1);turn(s,29371,20276);const event=es(s).find(e=>e.redCategory==='attribute');assert.equal(event.settledDamage,Math.floor(170*2**Math.floor(values.at(-1)/260)*E.typeEffectiveness('冰',s.fighters[1].type,s.typeChart)));assert.equal(event.hpLoss,event.settledDamage);assert.equal(s.round,3);});

success.name: 4000全部17招基础组件以不同双攻面板验证真实分类、源威力公式、HP变化及PP，明确隔离另行验证的效果指令

success.assertion: test('4000/2500最优五系只改克制倍数，2501整招封锁重算伤害按260特攻翻倍且不恢复强化命中词条，已命中零红不重算',()=>{const s=make({move:38423,index:0}),m=s.moveDefinitions[key(38423)],b=make({move:38423,index:-1});const max=Math.max(...['自然','光','冰','超能','神灵'].map(t=>E.typeEffectiveness(t,s.fighters[1].type,s.typeChart)));turn(s,38423,20309);turn(b,38423,20309);const old=E.typeEffectiveness(m.type,s.fighters[1].type,s.typeChart);assert.ok(Math.abs(red(s)/red(b)-max/old)<.05);const x=make({move:38421,aStats:{spa:520}}),reference=make({move:38421,index:-1,aStats:{spa:520}});reference.moveDefinitions[key(38421)].power*=4;reference.moveDefinitions[key(38421)].type='神灵';timer(x,0,'attackBlock',{});turn(x,38421,20309);turn(reference,38421,20309);assert.equal(red(x),red(reference));assert.ok(red(x)>0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].stages.atk,0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].effects['低体固定吸取失败真伤'],undefined);const y=make({move:38421,index:4});timer(y,1,'攻击伤害免疫',{});turn(y,38421,20309);assert.equal(red(y),0);});

success.assertion: test('4000/2493负先制按零档，残血仍按理论汲取回复，技能禁疗与真伤免疫分别处理',()=>{for(const priority of [-3,-1,0,1,2,4]){const s=make({move:38422,index:4,hp:1000,targetHp:1000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;known2493(s,priority);const n=340*2**Math.max(0,priority);assert.equal(es(s,'true')[0].settledDamage,n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+n);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp>=0);if(priority===4)assert.ok(es(s,'true')[0].hpLoss<n);}for(const mode of ['ban','immune']){const s=make({move:38422,index:4,hp:1000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');else timer(s,1,'当回合免伤');known2493(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='ban'?1000:1340);assert.equal(es(s,'true').reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0),mode==='immune'?0:340);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38422)],4);}});

success.name: 4000全部17招基础组件以不同双攻面板验证真实分类、源威力公式、HP变化及PP，明确隔离另行验证的效果指令
success.assertion: test('4000全部17招基础组件以不同双攻面板验证真实分类、源威力公式、HP变化及PP，明确隔离另行验证的效果指令',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,index:-1,aStats:{atk:180,spa:18}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);const events=(s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.targetSide===1&&e.type==='attack');if(m.kind==='status'){assert.equal(events.length,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);continue;}assert.equal(events.length,1);const event=events[0],attack=m.kind==='physical'?180:18,defense=m.kind==='physical'?s.fighters[1].stats.def:s.fighters[1].stats.spd;assert.equal(event.attackValue,attack,m.name);const log=s.turns[0].events.find(e=>e.damage?.sourceSide===0&&e.damage?.type==='attack'),roll=Number(log.detail.match(/浮动 (\d+)%/)[1]),base=Math.floor(Math.floor((2*s.fighters[0].level/5+2)*m.power*attack/defense)/50)+2,affinity=E.typeEffectiveness(m.type,s.fighters[1].type,s.typeChart),expected=affinity===0?0:Math.max(1,Math.floor(base*E.sameTypeBonus(m.type,s.fighters[0].type,s.typeChart)*affinity*roll/100));assert.equal(event.settledDamage,expected,m.name);assert.equal(event.hpLoss,expected);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000-expected);}});

success.name: 4000全部17招64种子基础验证与真实魂印完整链含2493七参、2492零盾罩，实际末位回复PP独立核对
success.assertion: test('4000全部17招64种子基础验证与真实魂印完整链含2493七参、2492零盾罩，实际末位回复PP独立核对',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),old=E.SOULS;let used=false;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&c.actualUsed&&c.m.kind!=='item')used=true;}};try{turn(s,m.id,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.id===38422?m.pp:m.pp-1+(used?1:0),m.name);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}});

success.assertion: test('4000/2493原七参数冗余尾参保留且真实恢复PP汲取，2492零盾罩相等不触发补偿',()=>{const s=make({move:38422,index:4});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(38422)].operations[0].sourceArgs,[4,1,17,1,1,1,1]);turn(s,38422,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(es(s,0,'true')[0].settledDamage,17);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38422)],source.moves.find(m=>m.id===38422).pp);const x=make({move:38420,index:3});turn(x,38420,20309);assert.equal(x.round,2);assert.equal(x.fighters[1].effects.statusBlock,undefined);assert.equal(x.fighters[1].soulState.switchRequest,undefined);assert.ok(red(x)>0);});

success.name: 4000/2493原七参数正常编译执行：真实恢复每点PP汲取17真伤并等量技能回复，实际先制2使伤害乘4，满PP仅补本招消耗1点
success.assertion: test('4000/2493原七参数正常编译执行：真实恢复每点PP汲取17真伤并等量技能回复，实际先制2使伤害乘4，满PP仅补本招消耗1点',()=>{for(const priority of[0,2]){const s=make({move:38422,index:4,hp:1000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;known2493(s,priority);const n=20*17*2**priority;assert.equal(es(s,'true').reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0),n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,priority);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[k],k===key(38422)?4:5);}const x=make({move:38422,index:4,hp:1000});known2493(x);assert.equal(es(x,'true')[0].settledDamage,17);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].hp,1017);});

success.assertion: test('4000/2493负先制按零档，残血仍按理论汲取回复，技能禁疗与真伤免疫分别处理',()=>{for(const priority of [-3,-1,0,1,2,4]){const s=make({move:38422,index:4,hp:1000,targetHp:1000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;known2493(s,priority);const n=340*2**Math.max(0,priority);assert.equal(es(s,'true')[0].settledDamage,n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+n);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp>=0);if(priority===4)assert.ok(es(s,'true')[0].hpLoss<n);}for(const mode of ['ban','immune']){const s=make({move:38422,index:4,hp:1000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');else timer(s,1,'当回合免伤');known2493(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='ban'?1000:1340);assert.equal(es(s,'true').reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0),mode==='immune'?0:340);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38422)],4);}});

success.name: 4000全部17招64种子基础验证与真实魂印完整链含2493七参、2492零盾罩，实际末位回复PP独立核对
success.assertion: test('4000全部17招64种子基础验证与真实魂印完整链含2493七参、2492零盾罩，实际末位回复PP独立核对',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),old=E.SOULS;let used=false;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&c.actualUsed&&c.m.kind!=='item')used=true;}};try{turn(s,m.id,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.id===38422?m.pp:m.pp-1+(used?1:0),m.name);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}});

success.assertion: test('4000/1922实际清回合后只封属性命中效果，1880偷强成功才下回增伤100无强则下两回先制1，2075未KO次回锁弱',()=>{const s=make({move:38423,index:1});timer(s,1,'免弱',{});turn(s,38423,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].effects['属性技能命中效果失效']);for(const positive of[false,true]){const x=make({move:38423,index:2});if(positive)x.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;turn(x,38423,20309);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].effects.id913?.bonus,positive?1:undefined);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].effects.id984?.amount,positive?undefined:1);if(positive)assert.equal(x.fighters[0].stages.atk,2);}const y=make({move:38423,index:3});turn(y,38423,20309);assert.equal(y.fighters[1].effects['弱化不可解除反转'].start,2);assert.equal(y.fighters[1].effects['弱化不可解除反转'].end,3);});

instance.description: 未击败对手时令对手全属性-1，未触发则对手2回合内无法主动切换精灵

raw.description: 此技能以自然、光、冰、超能、神灵系中的最优系别计算克制倍数；消除对手回合类效果，消除成功则2回合内对手属性技能命中效果失效；吸取对手能力提升状态，吸取成功则自身下1回合造成的攻击伤害提升100%，若对手不处于能力提升状态则自身下2回合先制+1；未击败对手则对手下2回合无法解除、反转自身能力下降状态；未击败对手时令对手全属性-1，未触发则对手2回合内无法主动切换精灵

success.assertion: test('4000/2351未KO全弱1，免弱或全负六失败才登记真实主动换宠限制',()=>{for(const blocked of[false,true]){const s=make({move:38423,index:4});if(blocked)timer(s,1,'免弱',{});turn(s,38423,20309);for(const n of Object.values(s.fighters[1].stages))assert.equal(n,blocked?0:-1);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].soulState.pendingSwitch23514000,blocked);}});
